title: Gerald Charles
description: Gerald Charles is a luxury watch brand offering a curated selection of high-end timepieces. The website delivers an immersive brand experience, built with Remix and Shopify's headless solution Hydrogen for seamless e-commerce integration.

content1.title: Crafted for detail
content1.subtitle: Luxury at every interaction
content1.label: Elegance
content1.text1: The website reflects Gerald Charles's commitment to craftsmanship through a refined visual language. High-quality imagery and video give visitors an intimate look at the collection, allowing them to explore the intricate details of each timepiece.
content1.text2: A store locator helps users find the nearest boutique, while the integrated e-commerce flow lets them purchase directly online. Product pages feature frame-by-frame animations that bring each watch to life, creating an engaging and memorable browsing experience.

title: Courchevel
description: Courchevel is one of the most prestigious alpine destinations, blending luxury with mountain adventure. The website is built with Next.js and Tailwind CSS, using Storyblok as the CMS and the Apidae API to deliver dynamic, real-time content about the resort and its surroundings.

content1.title: A premium digital experience
content1.subtitle: Refined and immersive
content1.label: Mountain
content1.text1: The website offers a comprehensive overview of everything Courchevel has to offer: activities, accommodations, dining, and services. The design mirrors the sophistication of the destination itself, with a clean and elegant aesthetic that guides visitors through the region's highlights.
content1.text2: The Apidae API integration ensures that events, weather conditions, and local information are always current and accurate. Combined with Storyblok, the client has full editorial control over every aspect of the site, enabling seamless content updates without developer intervention.

title: Ex Nihilo Paris
description: Ex Nihilo Paris is a luxury fragrance house in the heart of Paris. The website showcases their products and bespoke services through a refined e-commerce experience, built with Remix and Shopify Hydrogen, deployed on Shopify Oxygen for edge performance and scalability.

content1.title: Performance at the edge
content1.subtitle: Speed meets elegance
content1.label: Elegance
content1.text1: Built on Remix and Shopify Hydrogen, the platform leverages Oxygen's edge computing for exceptional load times and a seamless shopping experience across all devices. Every architectural decision prioritizes performance without compromising the brand's visual identity.
content1.text2: A full-featured customer account area gives users access to their order history, invoices, and account settings. This personalized space enhances the customer journey with transparent purchase tracking, while maintaining the refined aesthetic that defines Ex Nihilo.

content2.title: Parisian identity
content2.subtitle: Luxury meets functionality
content2.label: Paris
content2.text1: The design strikes a balance between modern e-commerce functionality and the brand's elegant visual language. Every page reflects Ex Nihilo's refined identity, from product discovery to checkout, creating an immersive experience rooted in Parisian luxury.
content2.text2: The Remix, Hydrogen, and Oxygen stack powers a robust platform that handles complex e-commerce flows while maintaining peak performance. From product browsing to order management, the architecture ensures a cohesive and efficient experience at every step.

title: Bertrand Hospitality
description: Bertrand Hospitality brings together exceptional venues under one identity, standing as a benchmark for French art de vivre. The website is built with Next.js and Tailwind CSS, powered by Storyblok for flexible content management.

content1.title: A refined presentation
content1.subtitle: Full editorial control
content1.label: Hospitality
content1.text1: The website delivers an immersive experience across Bertrand Hospitality's portfolio of venues. Careful attention to micro-interactions ensures the navigation feels smooth and intuitive, with subtle design details that enhance the user journey at every step.
content1.text2: Storyblok was chosen for its flexibility, giving the client full control over the content they display and highlight. A sidebar filtering system lets users explore locations based on criteria managed through the back-office, offering a tailored and efficient search experience.

title: Cloudy Bay
description: Cloudy Bay is an e-commerce platform built with Gatsby and Drupal for a subsidiary of the Moet Hennessy group. The site showcases their premium wine collection, allows event bookings across two locations, and handles multi-market content delivery. I contributed to its development during my internship at Ultranoir.

content1.title: Key features
content1.subtitle: A rich, multi-faceted platform
content1.label: Wine
content1.text1: The site connects visitors with e-retailers and partner stores carrying Cloudy Bay wines. Users can browse vintages by year and follow the brand's latest news via Instagram integration. A key technical challenge was managing multiple markets, dynamically showing or hiding content depending on the user's selected region.
content1.text2: For undecided visitors, the Wine Finder, developed by one of Ultranoir's engineers, recommends the ideal bottle based on personal preferences. Purchases are handled externally through WineDirect, keeping the platform focused on discovery and brand experience.

title: Eclipse
description: Eclipse is a design fiction project set in a dystopian future threatened by famine and overpopulation. To address the crisis, the state deploys sacrifice capsules throughout the city, where volunteers can give their lives in exchange for financial compensation for their families, calculated based on health and age.

content1.title: An immersive narrative
content1.subtitle: Where fiction meets interaction
content1.label: Eclipse
content1.text1: To present our concept, we designed an immersive website that walks visitors through the Eclipse universe. The main page introduces the project's narrative, while a digital booklet details the explanatory diagrams behind our vision. Darkprints break down each cabin component and its purpose, and a dedicated interface simulates the experience a volunteer would face upon entering.
content1.text2: The 3D models are showcased both in a traditional slider and through an immersive product page that explores the cabin in detail: exterior, interior, and the crematorium storage system. As a tribute to the volunteers, we also imagined a memorial tower where urns containing their ashes would be gathered, turning the space into a place of remembrance.

title: Table food Hall
description: Table Food Hall is a vibrant food destination in the heart of Toronto. The website highlights the diverse roster of food vendors and provides visitors with everything they need to plan their visit. Built with Nuxt.js and Tailwind CSS, it uses Dato CMS for content management.

content1.title: A culinary showcase
content1.subtitle: Toronto's food scene, online
content1.label: Food
content1.text1: The website captures the energy and diversity of Table Food Hall's culinary offerings. Each vendor is presented with dedicated content, alongside practical details about the venue. The design is modern and approachable, reflecting the lively atmosphere of the hall itself.
content1.text2: Dato CMS gives the client full autonomy over content updates, from adding new vendors and menus to promoting upcoming events. A blog section offers deeper stories about the food hall and its community. Nuxt.js powers a fast, responsive experience that keeps navigation smooth and intuitive across all devices.
